changes: New culinary dose 1500 g gross raw cured hock replaces 2200 g bone-in hock. Moab makes bone-in and boneless hock; the source label does not establish which, so the recipe explicitly handles either and removes any bones/tough skin. No bone or nutrient yield is inferred. Preserve salted broth use/discard and bay removal as unknown losses; count checks and draining as active work.
recipes.content_review: Rimmad lägg långkokas och serveras med rotmos som späds med en del av kokspadet; skild från stekt fläsk med bruna bönor och späckad karré.
